text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's just like me to choke when it matters
most,
but... it's still so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, you're so positive! I did do my
very best,
so I've got no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna really hit the track
from now
on so I can come in first next
time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I can't let myself be satisfied
with
results like these!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking home first place next time! I
hope my
fans can hold tight a little
longer!
